concept: Staying a learner in your field, even after you're considered competent
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic scenario where an experienced professional is tempted to coast on existing knowledge rather than update it
exercise.reflection_prompt: What's the cost of assuming you already know enough?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies one area of their own competence they've stopped actively learning in

assessment.success_marker: adult names a specific area and a concrete way to re-engage with learning in it
